request.description: Compiles the draft (purposes must exist, be active and be collectable by consent), hashes each item's text and opens a change request. Staff only. Consent templates are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): compliance makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then compliance publishes. The document key is the context clients ask for (e.g. `journey`, `lead_capture`). Each item's text is hashed so a record proves exactly what the person saw.
